finding: The CMS outpatient file covers Comprehensive APCs only (63,518 priced rows across 68 procedural APC groups, averaging $5,123 per service). Routine outpatient volume (lab, imaging, clinic, therapy) is absent. Using this as the outpatient average overstates blended claim value roughly tenfold.
treatment: Outpatient split into a procedural bucket priced from observed C-APC data and an ancillary bucket derived from the professional per-line rate with a facility uplift

finding: Issuer-level values repeat across all plan rows. Naive summation yields 157,772,405,042 claims against a true 1,875,320,210, a 84.1x overstatement
treatment: Deduplicated to issuer-year grain before any issuer-level aggregation

finding: Source header contains a stray trailing double quote
treatment: Mapped explicitly in config.COLUMN_MAP; a naive rename would drop the column

finding: 6250 plan-years where reason categories do not reconcile to reported total denials within 2 percent
treatment: Flagged via reason_reconciles=False; reason-mix analysis uses only reconciling rows, volume analysis uses all rows

treatment: Coerced to NULL; a rate above 100 percent indicates a source reporting error
